drafts.title: Clashing Approaches
drafts.reasoning: This scene showcases the tension between the gruff police captain and the youthful, principled officer while maintaining the calm presence of Noel in the background.
drafts.scene: The dimly lit conference room is filled with reports and diagrams scattered on a large table. Noel stands by the window, observing the action without intervening. Sierra sits quietly nearby, her expression a mix of concern and support for Noel.

dialogue.line: Captain, we need to think outside the box here! This isn't your typical arson investigation.
What do you mean 'outside the box'? You're just making things more complicated than they are.
And I don’t see you doing much outside the box, Captain. Maybe if you weren’t so stuck in your ways…
Professional my ass. We’re getting nowhere with this free labor nonsense. Stick to your fires, kid.
I’m working because I care about solving this case, even though no one pays me for it. And trust me, I’ve got some tasty snacks ready for when we hit a wall!
You hear that, John? Free labor is for amateurs. Now sit down and shut up until I say otherwise.
